purpose: Provide one explicit FT-001 integration and documentation sync gate before feature-level completion review.
success_outcome: FT-001 task evidence is coherent, docs are synchronized, and the feature is ready for feature-level red-verification after all tasks close.
anti_goals: No product feature verification without feature-level red-verification.
No new product behavior beyond FT-001 evidence sync.

forbidden_scope: feature-level verified lifecycle without feature red-verification

success_checks: All FT-001 unit/integration/API tests pass together.
Behavior specs are covered by task evidence or linked test output.
FT-001 Memory Bank docs, task record evidence, and changelog are synchronized without claiming FT-002/FT-003 completion.
Feature-level /red-verify --feature FT-001 remains required after all FT-001 tasks are done before treating the feature as complete.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.

stop_conditions: Any FT-001 prerequisite task is not done.
Evidence contains unredacted secrets or auth material.
Docs sync would imply FT-002 or FT-003 completion.
